༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang bskur gyi mtshams sbyor bshad pa bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// rab 'byams mu med zhing bzhugs rnam 'dren gyi// mkhyen rab rang gzugs ye shes me long nyid// ma rungs 'dul phyir khro bo cher sprul pa// bla ma dus dgra'i mgon pos rtag tu skyongs// gsang rgyud lam gyi rtsa ba bde chen gyi// snying po len pa'i grong khyer skal ba can// sems rgyud gzhi mar sku bzhi'i sa bon bzang*// bskyed bsrings cho ga rwa chen mkhas pa'i lugs// brgyud rim dam pa'i bde 'byung ral par brgyud// mtshams sbyor tshogs gsum rdzogs pa'i chab sgra 'bum// mang thos sgra 'dzin 'jebs pa'i dbyangs 'jo ba// smra mkhas skal bar ldan pa'i shing rtar grags// de'ang 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum gyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor la sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la slob ma rnams gral rim 'khod pa la khrus dang*/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas 'di skad ces brjod do// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang snyam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa'ang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i snod kyi skyon gsum spangs nas legs par gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba dam pa'i chos ni/ rang re rnams kyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang yon tan mnga' ba de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don dpag med du mdzad pa las/

mdzad pa de rnams kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa ni/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi 'grel pa las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis bkru bar mi mdzad cing*// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal phyag gis kyang ni sel mi mdzad// nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo ba mi mdzad mod// chos nyid yang dag bstan pas grol bar mdzad pa yin// zhes bshad pa ltar/ gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal rjes su 'tsham pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs te/ mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung por mthun par gsungs// zhes so// de la dbye na theg pa chung ngu nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa gnyis su gnas pa las/ phyi ma khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul yang chos bdun gyis khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni// de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag grub pa chen po ste// chen po 'di dag dang ldan pas// theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags// zhes so// theg pa chen po de la'ang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis las/ phyi ma khyad chos bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul yang*/ tshul gsum gyi sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes so// sngags kyi theg pa de la'ang grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rnams kyis rgyud sde so so'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'grel tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rgyud sde gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*/ bzhi dang*/ lnga dang*/ drug tu 'dod pa'i bar yod kyang*/ don la rgyud sde bzhir nges pa'ang*/ gang zag phyi lus ngag gi bya ba khrus dang gtsang sbrar dga' ba rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/

phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang nang ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam du spyod par dga' ba rnams la spyod pa'i rgyud/ ting nge 'dzin kho na gtso bor spyod par dga' ba rnams la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gong na med pa gtso bor spyod par dga' ba rnams la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud rnams gsungs pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la// zhes so// gdul bya 'dod khams kyi sems can la chags par 'jug tshul bzhi yod pa dang*/ rgyal rigs la sogs pa mi rigs bzhi yod pa dang*/ phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams la lta ba ngan pa bzhi yod pa dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la grub mtha' smra ba bzhi yod pa la sogs pas rgyud sde rin po che bzhir bzhag ste/ de skad du'ang saṃ pu ṭa las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang*// dgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yis// srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas// zhes dang*/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ mi rigs bzhi dang dus tshod bzhi// nyon mongs sgo nas dbye ba yis// 'di ni rgyud dang mthun par gda'// zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyud sde bzhir nges pa las/ 'di ni de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin/ bla na med pa'i rgyud la'ang thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyud dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang gsum las/ 'dir gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas thabs kyi rgyud du gzhag pa ste/ de la nang gsel gyi dbye ba/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ gdul bya 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud dang*/ gdul bya zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir gshin rje gshed kyi skor dang*/

gdul bya gti mug can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud rnams gsungs pa las 'dir gshin rje gshed kyi skor/ de la'ang gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum du yod pa las/ 'dir phyi ma gnyis te/ de la rtsa ba'i rgyud dam/ de'i nang nas phyung ba dgra nag gi rgyud tshigs su bcad pa phyed dang lnga brgya pa dang*/ de'i bshad rgyud rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bdun pa dang*/ gdong drug gi rgyud du 'jog pa'ang yod la/ rje sa chen gyis rtog bdun 'grel ba las ni/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang 'phros pa'i rgyud gnyis yin la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud ni 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud khri drug stong pa zhes bya ba yod la/ de'i le'u drug pa glur blangs pa'i le'u logs su phyung ba/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa 'di yin/ 'di nyid las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// ces pa las/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs// ces pa las gdong drug gi rgyud dang*/ mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan// zhes pa las dgra nag gi rgyud rnams 'phros par bzhed do// de dag gi nang nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud la yang rgyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis yod pa'i rgyas pa ni stong phrag bco brgyad pa zhes pa'am/ mi bskyod pa'i 'grel pa las ni 'bum pa las phyung ba zhes 'byung bas rgyud 'bum pa'o// brtag pa sum brgya pa las phyung ba zhes 'byung bas/ de lta bu'i rgyud rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus pa ni/ de nyid kyi brtag pa nyer gcig pa rig 'dzin grub pa'i rtog pa sogs nas/ nyer gnyis pa 'khor lo gsum bkod pa'i rtogs pa logs su phyung ba/ da ltar rtog bdun du grags pa 'di yin/ rtog gsum dang rtog pa gcig pa la sogs pa ni rgyud rnam dag kyang ma yin la/ te'u lo pa'i rtog pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi le lag logs su phyung ba yin no// 'di la mi bskyod pa'i 'grel par/

le'u bdun pa rtog pa gcig par yang gsungs so// bla ma gong ma rnams ni rtog pa bdun pa zhes bzhed pa'i rtog pa dang por sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan/ rtog pa gnyis par 'khrul 'khor/ gsum par sngags btu ba/ bzhi par sgrub thabs/ lnga par bris sku'i cho ga drug par sbyin sreg bdun par bsam gtan gyis las grub pa'i tshul rnams ston pas so// 'di'i rtog pa dang po la brten nas grub chen la li ta badzras rdo rje 'jigs byed lha zhe dgu'i sgrub thabs zhi khro rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ 'di'i srol 'dzin zhang shes rab bla ma la sogs pa la bka' babs pa lha bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sogs la rdo rje 'jigs byed zhang lugs zhes grags/ yang de la brten nas grub chen a mo gha badzras rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun gyi sgrub thabs sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ de'i brgyud pa skyo 'od 'byung sogs nas brgyud pa lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag dang bcas pa la rdo rje 'jigs byed skyo lugs zhes grags/ yang de nyid kyis dngos bstan rdo rje 'jigs byed lha dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor la paṇḍi ta shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang bcas pa rje sa skya pa rnams la bka' babs pa zhig dang*/ bla ma rwa pa rnams la bka' babs pa zhig ste gnyis las/ dang po ni grub chen nā ro pa nas brgyud pa rje sa skya pa rnams la bka' babs pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed lha dgu'i dbang dang*/ rgyud kyi bshad bka' dang bcas pa la sa lugs zhes grags pa dang*/ phyi ma rwa rdo rje grags kyis mdzad pa'i zhal dgu rin chen sgron ma la sogs pa sgrub thabs bzhi mdzad la/ 'di'i bka' babs lo tsā ba de nyid nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang bcas pa'i chos skor la rwa lugs zhes grags pa dang*/

yang de nyid kyis dngos su bstan pa med kyang*/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas/ gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud nas kha bskang ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la gti mug gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i lha bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba de la/ rwa lo tsā ba chen po rdo rje grags pa nas rim bzhin tshar chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras sogs nas brgyud de 'ongs pa la rwa lugs thun mong ma yin pa rnams su grags pa las/ 'dir phyi ma rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sgrub pa'i skabs su babs te/ de la spyir dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon sogs spro na spyi ltar brjod/ de la rjes gzung bsnyen pa sa chog dang*// sta gon bri dgram sgrub cing mchod// 'jug cing dbang blang rjes chog go /zhes pa ltar/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun nam brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ rjes gzung bsnyen pa gcig tu bgrang ba sngon du song ba'i khul du bgyid tshe/ nub gnyis pa sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin zhes sam/ ras bris ltar na sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ nub dang po sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ zhes skabs gang bab brjod/ de la sa'i lha mo dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa sta gon te gsum po sngon du song nas/ slob ma sta gon la/ khrus byas yon dbul spro ba bskyed// gsol gdab bur bya sdom pa gzung*// byin rlabs mchod dang so shing sbyin// khyor chu blud dang ku sha sbyin// srung skud gdags dang chos zab bshad// tshogs mchod btang nas rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar chos bcu bzhi yod pa las/ thog mar phyi rol du las thams cad pa'i chus khrus byas te gral la 'khod de/ slob dpon la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te/

rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po thams cad gling bzhi ri rab la sogs pa lha mi'i dpal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul te phul bar mos la maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇḍal tshom bu bdun pa'i mthar/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan rnams// nor bu rin chen gyis bkang ste// stong gsum la sogs ma lus pa// zhum pa med par byas te 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā gu ru maṇḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes phul nas gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ rjes su gnang ba'i 'khor bzhi po// rang gi bslab dang shin tu ldan// theg pa chen po'i blo can la// bde gshegs yang dag cho ga gsungs// la la gsang sngags grub don gnyer// 'dir ni dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i// dad pa mang du byed pa yi// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya'o// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod mi bya// tshe 'dir 'dod par gyur pa la// 'jig rten pha rol don mi 'byung*// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer gyis// 'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas// de bas 'jig rten gzhan bsgrub phyir// khyod kyis brtan pa'i yid kyis gyis// zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni gdul bya thun mong ba dge tshul dang*/ dge slong pha ma'i rten gyis dbye ba'i 'khor bzhi dag la chos 'dul ba nas bshad pa'i bslab bya rnams slob par rjes su gnang zhing*/ theg chen gyi rigs can thun mong ba rnams la ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pas bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs rgya cher gsungs la/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i ngor gsungs pa'i sngags kyi dngos grub rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes don du gnyer ba dag

dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya yi/ tshe 'di'i bde 'byor dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang dang*/ rang don du nyan rang gi byang chub 'dod pa rnams ni ma yin te/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug par ma ltos par thabs dman pa gzhan la brten nas bsgrub tu yod pa'i phyir ro// de bas na bdag gzhan thams cad srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba'i dad pa can/ blo gros dang ldan pa dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya ste/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras don du gnyer bas zhugs na pha rol gyi don mi 'grub cing*/ gzhan don du mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas la dmigs te zhugs na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa yin no// de bas na khyed rnams theg chen gyi tshul 'di las yid gzhan du mi 'gyur bar gyis shig ces pa ste/ de ltar nges par byas nas bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin te/ de rnams sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod na/ sems can dmyal ba pa rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams gcig la gcig za ba dang dang gsod pa dang bkol spyad kyi sdug bsngal/ mi rnams la 'dod pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa dang mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang lus bcad cing dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams la 'chi 'pho dang gong ma nas 'og tu ltung bar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ gzugs dang gzugs med kyi khams na'ang*/ zag bcas kyi dge ba'i 'phen shugs rdzogs nas/ log par lta bas sems bslus pa'i dbang gi ngan song ngan 'gro la sogs par ltung par 'gyur bar shes nas sems kyi sdug bsngal rnams yod par bshad/

'o na sdug bsngal de dag las rang nyid gcig pu thar pa'i nyan rang gi byang chub thob par bya dgos pa yin nam snyam na/ ma yin te nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs shing*/ gzhan don gyi phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung zhing*/ mthar 'tshang rgya ba la yun ring du byed pas/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis don du gnyer ba'i 'bras bu ma yin/ 'o na ci zhig don du gnyer bya yin zhe na/ shes rab chen po'i 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas par khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal las 'das shing*/ snying rje chen po'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas par sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'ang rang nyid gcig pu'i don du ma yin te/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can re re nas kyang rang re rnams kyi pha mar byas shing*/ byas res kyi gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyabs shing phan 'dogs tshad med pa bsgrubs pa'i drin chen sha stag yin mod/ 'di rnams 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang*/ de sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis/ la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling thog gis ni ldongs/ thar pa'i rten gyi khar ba dang ni bral/ dge ba'i bshes kyi dmigs bu bas ni ma zin/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam nas brdeg 'chos shing*/ ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar 'phyan pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du mos pa mdzod/ snying rje'o snyam nas bzhag pas mi phan/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral nas bde ba la dgod dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag las lhag pa'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa 'ga' zhig la'ang med/

su zhig la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de yang rgyu med rkyen med las thob par mi 'gyur bas/ rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par blangs nas dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam bgyid pa dang lam la ci nus kyis 'bad pa las 'byung bar nges pa'i phyir/ de ltar bgyi snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dung ba zhig bskyed 'tshal/ bsam pa de lta bus kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhing*/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar byung gi tshul gyis 'byung ba yin no// nang dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas sku lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyi zhal nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ lha mo'i padmar babs pa skad cig gis gti mug gshin rje'i gshed du gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ lha mo'i padmar khyed rnams gnas pa'i spyi bo nas thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig tu byung bar mos/ slar yang slob dpon gyi hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas 'thon te rang rang gi gral la 'khod par mos pa mdzod/

de ltar bya ba'i dgos pa ni dbang gi dngos gzhi ma thob kyi bar du gsang ba'i chos rnams nyan pa'i snod rung du byed pa dang*/ de dag gi bar du slob dpon la gsang sgrogs kyi ltung ba mi 'byung ba'i ched du bsgrubs pa yin no// de nas sngags kyi dngos grub don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag nas/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni/ slob dpon la dga' chen zhes bos nas/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag la 'tshal ba'i slad du/ dam tshig ste sngags kyi sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags las thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa stsal ba'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du gzhug tu gsol/ zhes pa'o// de ltar khyad par can gyi lam rdo rje theg pa la don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa de shin tu legs pa yin no zhes spro ba bskyed pa'am bur bya ba 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// dus gsum 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni// ye shes mnyam pa med pa brnyes// shākya seṅge sogs mchog gis// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// gang gi stobs kyis bdud kyi sde// shin tu mi bzad chen po bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug spyad nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces pa ste/ de'i don ni/ khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas bur byas zin pa de la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos nas/ khyed rnams theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ mchog tu gyur pa sngags kyi theg pa de khyed rnams la yang dag par bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing*/ khyad par 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la sogs pa'ang bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud kyi sde mi bzad pa rnams bcom nas sangs rgyas su zin na'ang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i slad du/ slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ rtag par zhen pa rnams bzlog pa'i phyir du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa yin no// de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba bzang ba yin pas/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen po thob pa'i phyir/ chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa la blo brtan par gyis shig ces pa'o// blo brtan pa'i slob mas sdom pa gzung bar khas blang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas la/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags snyam pa sogs spyi ltar brda sprad de/

don de rnams yid la dran pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs nas 'grub par shog ces rgyud dag par byas nas/ slar yang yul de dag gi spyan sngar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams gzung bar khas len pa la gzung bya'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig gnyis su 'du ba las/ dang po ni gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i smon pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ de'i ched du nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum so sor gzung ba yin/ gnyis pa so so'i dam tshig la/ rnam snang gi dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa yin te/ rnam snang sangs rgyas kyi sku yin pas yon tan gyi rten byed pa ltar/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom pas kyang sdom pa thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i phyir ro// mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ni/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rdo rje dril bu/ phyag rgya slob dpon rnams 'dzin pa ste/ mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje byang chub sems kyi ngo bo yin pa ltar/ dam tshig gsum dang slob dpon yang byang chub kyi sems kyis 'dzin pas so// rin 'byung gi dam tshig ni/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos byams pa'i sbyin pa rnams nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug tu gtong ba'am/ dngos su mi nus pas kyang 'dun pa dang ma bral bar bya ba ste/ rin 'byung sbyin pa'i ngo bo ser sna rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ sbyin pas dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang*/ ser sna'i gnyen por byed pas so// 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig ni/ phyi bya spyod/ nang rnal 'byor/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla med de rgyud sde bzhi dang*/ nyan thos rang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ste theg pa gsum dang bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin par dam 'cha' ba ste/

'od dpag med shes rab kyi ngo bo gsung rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ chos kyang shes rab kyis 'dzin cing gsung gis ston pas so// don yod grub pa'i dam tshig ni/ sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang mchod pa'i las la brtson par bya ba yin te/ don yod grub pa brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo phrin las kyi rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ dge ba la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyis sdom pa 'dzin pa dang sangs rgyas la mchod pa byed pa gnyis ka sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rjes su skyong ba yin pas so// de lta bu'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs bzung nas bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du bgyis nas/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs lan gsum byas pas thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing*/ thob pa yar 'phel du byed/ nyams na sor chud par byed pa yin/ de'i steng du rigs lnga'i dam tshig rnams kyang gzung bar khas blangs pas sdom pa gzung ba la dbang ba tsam ste/ dam tshig sdom pa'i gtso bo ni dbang bskur ba las skye bar 'gyur ba yin no// de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched du bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum du yas mar reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po ā yis mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams lam gyis byung*/ slar yang mas yar reg ste/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas/ phyag mtshan dang sa bon de dag las thugs kar thugs rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

dpral bar sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa rnams su gyur/ slar yang yas mar reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas de dag brtan par byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pas khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa de cho ga 'dis ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar byas pa yin/ de ltar sems bskyed cing sgo gsum lhar byas ma thag pa de mchod pa'i yul du byed pa'ang*/ mdo las/ 'od srungs zla ba tshes pa la phyag bya'i/ nya ba la ni ma yin no// 'od srungs de bzhin du sems dang por bskyed pa la phyag bya'i/ sangs rgyas la ni ma yin no// zhes dang*/ sgo gsum lhar byas pa la mchod pa'ang*/ rgyal bu rgyal sar dbang bskur ma thag pa la thams cad kyis mchod pa byed pa lta bu ste/ me tog dbu la phul te mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ bdug spos shangs la dhū pe/ mar me spyan lam du ā lo ke dri'i byug pa thugs kar gandhe/ zhal zas ljags la ni wi dya/ zhes pas mchod pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don to// de ltar lhar bskyed cing mchod nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i ched du thog mar so shing la brten nas brtag pa ni/ so shing las bum gyi chu dang*/ bighnā na sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa/ rtse mo la me tog gi cod paṇa bcings pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang bcom ldan 'das kyi snying pos byin gyis brlabs te/ phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byin pa'i de so shing rgyu rin po che las grub par bsams te/ so'i rtsa bar drud pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer byung ba zhal nas brgyud de khong par song bas/

tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin skyugs par mos la/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas gsor te/ oṃ badzra ha sa ha zhes brjod cing*/ maṇḍal tshom bu lnga byas pa'i steng du dor cig de ltar dor bas rtse mo slob dpon dang rang la bstan na mchog 'grub/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ mtshams rnams su dngos grub phran tshegs 'grub par 'gyur ro// spro na/ de ni rnal 'byor chen po'i bum dbang gi snod rung byed pa'i thabs yin zhes sogs kyang brjod/ mi spro na ma bshad kyang rung ngo*// rmi lam gsal por 'byung ba dang*/ ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i bsang chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi ngag gi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces dang*/ baṃ lan bdun bzlas la/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha dharma nishtsa sya sarba saṃ sho dha ya/ sarba bi ka lbān a pa na ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas khyor bar lan gsum sbyin la 'thung du gzhug go /spro na 'di ni gsang dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin sogs brjod/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i phon che chung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥdang hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha che chung rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces dang*/ dhīḥdang hūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ dhīḥbazlas pa'i ku sha chung ba oṃ badzrā tikṣ+ṇa dhīḥzhes sngas dang*/ ha bzlas pa'i che ba oṃ badzā tikṣ+ṇa hūm̐/

stan gyi don du byin/ spro na de'i don ku sha 'di ni 'dag byed sogs brjod/ sngon byung bcom ldan 'das ku sha mi 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin du/ rjes 'jug rnams kyang ku sha'i stan la nyal te rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon du byas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa'o// rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir srung skud 'dogs pa ni/ hūm̐ bzla zhing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab pa'i srad bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig gi srad bu la thim zhes dang*/ srung skud thal mo'i bar bzung la/ hrīḥṣṭiḥlan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ buddha mai tri rakṣa rakṣa sarbān swā hā/ zhes pas skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su nyis bskor du bcings te las bum gyi chus gtor te bsrung ngo*// spro na de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi snod rung sogs brjod do// chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten 'di ni kun mkhyen sogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni/ 'jig rten na u dumbā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sogs spyi ltar bshad/ de nas rwa chen gyis dkyil 'khor cho gar bshad pa ltar/ tshogs gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ dkyil 'khor la skal ba gcig drangs/ phud la gtor ma gcig bcad/ tshogs la longs spyod de/ mthar lhag ma bsdus/ sngar phud bcad pa 'phrog ma la zan chang byin gyis brlabs pa/

oṃ ha ri te biṇḍa kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas 'phrog mar zan chang gsum gyi gtor ma sbyin/ oṃ hu ti ke a gra gha pa saṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas kha phud kyi gtor ma dbul/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi utstshiṣṭa pa liṃ ta bhakṣa ka swā hā/ zhes pas lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la lhag ma'i gtor ma dbul lo// de nas rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*// rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun nga la drang por smros// zhes bshad pas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang par dkyil 'khor la phyogs par ram/ yang na rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bde ba'i mal stegs la/ slob dpon gyis byin pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du btings/ gos dri ma med pa bgos/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab ste seṅge nyal stabs kyis nyal te/ sems dug gsum gyi rnam rtog thag bsrings te/ lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas/ hrīḥṣṭ+riḥ'i snying po zlos shing*/ sang nyin yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i sgo nas nyal na lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni// yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin// mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong*// de la mchod pa rtsom pa dang*// dge slong dag las chos nyan tam// yang na mi nyan na yang rung*// chos ni rnam par spyod pa dang*// de bzhin mdo sde rnam par spyod// ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang*/ mchod rten mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam thogs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su zhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma las chos nyan pa/ dge slong dag dang chos kyi 'bel gtam byed pa/ 'bru'am bang mdzod la sogs pa'i gter rnyed pa/

skye bo mang pos bdag la 'dud bstod byed pa/ skye bo mang po la bdag gis chos bshad pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ khrus byas pa/ gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan pa/ mtshon cha rnyed pa/ chu las brgal ba la sogs pa rmis na rmi lam bzang ba yin pas sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring gang rung 'grub par shes nas/ zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba sgom zhing dga' ston bya/ gal te ngan pa'ang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa/ ka ra wī ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ mchod sdong dang bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon te kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mo dang ma he la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyod pa/ 'dam rdzab tu bying ba/ chu dong du lhung ba/ ri rtse nas lhung ba/ khang pa rdib pa/ ljon shing chag pa/ mi nag po lcags kyi dbyig pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ skra bregs pa/ lus til mar gyis byugs pa/ phreng ba dmar pos thod bcings pa la sogs pa byung na cung zad ngan pa yin pas/ gnyid sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med de/ yum las/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa las gzhan pa'i chos shig yod na'ang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos gang yang don la grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bden med kyi sbyang pa'i rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba la sogs pas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin no// de rnams kyi slob ma sta gon gyis bya ba rnams grub zin nas/ 'di'i dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sang nyin 'byung ba lags/ zhes brjod do// dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa'ang rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par 'tshal/ de la rang re rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re byed dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ kye rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pa ltar/ don dam par sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin na'ang*/ gnas skabs su glo bur gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la/ byis pa mi shes pas bsgribs pas// de yis 'gro ba mi shes par// 'gro ba drug gi srid pa'i mthar// gang zhig rmongs pas 'khor bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal gyi khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor bar skye zhing*/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes kyang bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das pa yin te/ sdug bsngal can gyi sems can de rnams kyi pha mar ma byas pa 'ga' yang med pa'i phyir/ 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhag pa'i slad du/ tshe 'di'i bya ba snying po med pa thams cad spangs te/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po dang shes rab chen po zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i go 'phang rin po che thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du bden gnyis zung 'jug tu rtogs pa'i lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas/

bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid dang ni// rdzogs pa yi yang rim pa nyid// rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po ni rim pa gnyis yin la/ de'i sngon du bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum mtha' rten dang bcas pa blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa bskyed mdzod/ de la sta gon du gnas pa yan chad legs par grub nas/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ mjug gi cho ga dang bzhi yod pa las/ bri ba la thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mtshan ma dgod pa/ rgyan dgram pa ste bzhi dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa la/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin du sgrub pa/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa ste bzhi dang*/ nang du dkyil 'khor pa mchod pas mnyes par bya ba/ phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gtor mas tshim par bya ba rnams dgos te/ de dag ni sngon du legs par grub par byas so// ras bris ltar na/ gong gi dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ mjug gi cho ga ste gsum las/ sgrub cing mchod pa la sogs sngar bzhin brjod pas grub bo// 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po bdag nyid mjug cing dbang blang dgos pa'ang*/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ sngags kyi lam ni rjes btsal bas// gang tshe mkhas pas dbang bskur bas// sangs rgyas kun gyis mngon sum du// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas dag

/rang byin brlabs pa'i gnas thob nas// dam tshig nyams pa'i 'jigs pa yis// blo dang ldan pas de bzhin blangs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu dus su bla ma mkhas pas rang la dbang bskur ba bzhin/ rang gis kyang blang ba'i yul bla ma dang sangs rgyas kun mngon sum du mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas su bzhugs par dmigs nas/ dam tshig nyams pa gso ba'i blos/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang thams cad bdag 'jug gi tshul gyis len pa ste/ slob dpon rang la dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa yod pa sor chud pa dang*/ slob ma la sdom pa phog pas skye zhing rgyud smin pa'i bdag rkyen nus pa'i phyir/ shin tu gal che na'ang*/ de dag sngon du legs par grub par bgyis/ de'i rjes su phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i phyir du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir du dam tshig gi glu dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi bden par bsgrags pa dgos pa rnams legs par grub par byas pa yin no// da khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis las/ dang po phyi nang gi 'jug pa la/ khrus byas maṇḍal gsol ba gdab// bdun dag rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung*// mig dar me tog gtad byin brlabs// bgegs bskrad gsang gdams sems bskyed bya// dris lan byas te nang khrid bzhag /phyag 'tshal dam bzhag ye shes dbab// gsol gdab ltas brtag me tog dor// gdong dbye dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o// zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar las bum gyi chus khyed rnams kyi kha la sogs dag par byas nas gral rim ltar 'khod cing snyim pa me tog dang bcas te/ slob dpon la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba mdzod/

de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ e ma ho sangs rgyas nas/ gshin rje sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor du// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang sogs nas sta gon ltar dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum dang*/ slar yang de dag gi spyan sngar rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs nas mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ 'dzin rgyu'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i gtso bo dbang bskur ba las skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ dbang bskur ba dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas sngon chad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du hūm̐ las byung ba'i mig dar dmar po res gdong bcings te/ oṃ tsakṣu nas hūm̐ zhes pas gdong bcings nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong du mjal mi btub pas phyag rten gyi slad du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i me tog gi phreng ba re yang byin te/ u dumbā ra nas hūm̐ zhes pas byin nas/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas gnas gsum du reg pa sta gon gyi skabs ltar thig le byas te/ bgegs bskrad pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can mang du chad de/ khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i bgegs dang*/ dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/

ces dang las bum gyi chus gtor zhing*/ bighnān sogs kyis bskrad de/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun du spyod pa rnams snod dang mi ldan pa'i mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/ dus 'di nyid nas gsang bar mdzod ces gsang bar gdams nas/ nang gi rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis/ sa ma ya aḥzhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu zhig dang*/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig bsams te/ de lta bu'i bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ zhes pas sems bskyed pa de snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ ho siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas te/ rigs nges pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis/ kye bu sdug pa khyod su zhes dris par lan btab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa bdag lags so zhes brjod/ 'dod pa nges pa'i phyir/ ci la dga' zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde ba chen po la'o// zhes brjod/ slar yang slob dpon gyis/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes bde ba chen po sangs rgyas kyi dam tshig 'dod pa de dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas bye ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa zhig gi dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid par mos nas/ gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/

ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes brjod pas yol ba'i nang du zhugs nas/ der slob dpon gyis/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ zhes brjod pas padma'i gdan re byung ba'i steng du khyed rnams 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ nang du zhugs pa'i bya ba la/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i sgo ba bzhis khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khrid de/ de nyid nas sku gsung thugs la phyag bya ba'i mos pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na ma te hūm̐/ mgrin par sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na ma mi hūm̐/ snying gar sbyar te/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes pas phyag byas pa dang*/ sgo ba bzhi pos/ oṃ badzra uṅgha ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi thal gyis phye bar bsam/ de nas shar sgo nas khyed rnams gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis/ thal mo spyi bor sbyar te byin gyis brlab par gsol ba'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā nas a dhi tiṣṭha swa mi māṃ/ zhes dang*/ slar yang g.yas skor gyis phyin te/ lho sgo nas ser sna gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo dpral bar sbyar te dbang bskur bar gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā nas a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes dang*/ nub sgo nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo mgrin par sbyar te chos ston par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā nas pra bart+ta na yā māṃ zhes dang*/ byang sgo nas phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar te phrin las bsgrub par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā nas karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes dang*/ slar yang shar sgo nas 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal gyis/ dngos grub thams cad stsol bar gsol ba'i yid kyis thal mo snying gar sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā nas pra yatstshantu māṃ/

zhes pas dkyil 'khor la phyag dang bskor ba byas nas/ nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa'i sngon 'gro dam bzhag bzhi las/ dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ ye shes gang gi nas gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying gar rdo rjes gtugs te/ gshin rje gshed po nas dral te gshegs/ zhes dang*/ 'di yang nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas te/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi nas 'gems par byed do// zhes dang*/ thun mong du mna' chu sbyin pa'i sgo nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi bdud rtsi nas ṭha ṭha/ zhes dang*/ slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ de ring phyin chad nas ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pa'i dam bzhag gi rim pa rnams song nas/ nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba'am sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i ngang nas/ khyed rnams rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ badzra bhe ra wa ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i rkang mthil zhes pa nas/ has mtshan pa rnams gsal btab/ de nas slob dpon la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos pas zhes sogs nas/ me'i 'od zer dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rnam pa can dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rnams kyi sku lus kyi spyi bo'i gtsug dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib kyis thim par mos pa mdzod/

ces dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ mtshal chen 'bab pa'i bu mo'i gos// gu gul dag dang rnam par bsres// zhes dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mdoms mtshan phyis pa'i ras la ni// byi la'i stug par bcas pa dag /ces gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams bdud rtsir bsres la bsreg cing bdug la/ hrīḥṣṭiḥdang*/ oṃ tiṣṭha ma hā la sogs pa'i sngags rnams brjod cing yang yang dbab bo// phebs pa'i rtags ni/ dus 'khor las/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'bab pa yis// bdud kyi tshogs ni bsdigs par 'gyur// g.yon brkyang la sogs lta stangs dang*// rdo rje thogs dang gar byed do// sku babs pa yi rnal 'byor gyis// sku yi bya ba byed par 'gyur// gsung babs pa yis smra ba po// thugs babs pa yi rnal 'byor gyis// sems la gnas pa thams cad dang*// 'das dang ma 'ongs shes par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par byas nas/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣṭha badzras brtan par bya'o// ye shes dngos su phebs pa'i slob ma'i lce la a bsams la rdo rjes reg la/ rdo rje chos ni mgon po che// snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che// smros shig 'dod chags chen po pa// dge dang mi dge legs par smros// zhes brjod pas smra bar 'gyur ro// de ltar ye shes phebs pa de lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprod pa'i slad du/ dkyil 'khor la gsol ba 'debs pa slob dpon gyis bgyi dgos pas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i slad du/ khyed rnams mig mig ras dang bcas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la gzigs pas spyan lam du kha dog gang mthong ba zhig nged la smra dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam na ci snang zhes dris pas/ dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ nag po mngon spyod/ khra bo las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// dkyil 'khor la me tog 'bul ba ni/

'di na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su dag pa gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir gtso 'khor gyi rnam par bstan pa tsam las/ rang gi ngo bo la mchog dman gyi khyad par nam yang yod pa ma yin yang*/ rang rang gi skye ba snga ma'i lha skal dang mjal ba'i ched/ ngas lha la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// zhes brjod la/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan sogs dang*/ gti mug rdo rje sogs kyis bstod la/ sngar gyi me tog de rgyu rin po che las grub pa gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tu phul bar bsams la/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥzhes gsung zhing 'bul ba zhu/ me tog phog pa'i lha des rang gi rna ltag g.yon du bzhag par mos la/ sems dpa' stobs po che nas ba la oṃ/ mig 'bras gnyis su oṃ re bsgom mdzod/ gshin rje gshed po nas/ pra we sha ya phaṭa/ ces pas ma rig pa'i ling thog dang mig ras mnyam du bsal nas/ dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po nas sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ khyod kyi yi dam gyi lha gzhal yas khang gi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi pa nyid yin pas sgrubs shig ces dang*/ gang la blta bar bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ 'di na dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang phyi rol du rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sogs nas/ gdan gyi bar mngon rtogs ltar bstan te/ de dag ni rten gzhal yas khang yin la/ brten pa lha ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed nas sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i bar mngon rtogs rgyas pa'am/ dkyil 'khor dang lha'i mtshan tsam rags bsdus shig brjod pas kyang btub ste gang bab byas/

de ltar na lhag pa'i lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i bkod pa ltar mthong snyam pas dga' ba'i blos slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nas maṇḍal ho/ de rnams kyis lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la bzhi ste/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ mchog dbang gsum/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la/ slob mas gsol btab slob dpon gyis/ brab mchod sngon 'gro'i gsol ba btab/ dbang lnga bskur ba dngos gzhi'o// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ji ltar sangs rgyas nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ las bum gyi chu dang nyungs kar gyis brab pa'i tshul dang*/ bighnān gyi sngags dang bcas pas bgegs bsal nas/ gnang ba nod pa'i phyir slob dpon gyi

rwa chen gyis/ mdun du rdo rje 'jigs byed rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal ba la mchod pa sogs bshad pa shin tu 'brel chags mod/ 'dir phyi ma rnams kyis gsar du spyan 'dren pa mdzad srol byung 'dug pa sor bzhag byas/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis thal mo sbyar te/ rdo rje 'chang gi nas sbyin par mdzod/ ces pas lha la gsol ba btab pas/ lha tshogs de dag gi zhal nas/ bu dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin na dbang bskur cig ces gnang ba stsal bar bsam/ de nas byur bsal ba'i phyir las kyi rdo rjes las bum dang rnam rgyal gnyis bteg slob dpon gyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang bcas te/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs shlau ka gsum gyis shis pa brjod do// de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i sbyor ba'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la 'di ltar nges par bya dgos te/ kye rdo rje las/ sangs rgyas ma yin sems can ni// gcig kyang yod pa ma yin no// dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*// lha dang lha min mi rnams dang*// bshang ba'i srin bu la sogs pa// lha dang lha ma yin gyis kyang*// bde ba gang phyir mi shes pa// rtag tu rang bzhin bde ba can// zhes pa ltar/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa rang bzhin bde ba chen po skye 'gro thams cad la khyab par bzhugs na'ang*/ sems ni rang bzhin rnam rtog gis// skye bo dri mas nag por byas// zhes pa ltar/ kun rdzob bag chags 'khrul ba'i dbang gis/ nga dang nga yir bzung ba la brten nas byung ba'i phung po khams dang skye mched du snang ba ma 'gags kyi bar du 'khor bar sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pas/

de phyir kun tu rab 'bad pas// sems kyi rdo rje sbyang bar bya// sems dag pa ni bde ba yin// nyon mongs dug rnams 'phrog par byed// ces pa ltar sems nyid kun du sbyang bar bya dgos shing*/ de sbyangs pas phung khams sogs phyi rol gyi chos ltar snang ba rnams kyang rang gi ngang gis ldog par 'gyur te/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing gang zag med// rnam par shes pa'i gnas don nam// phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med// ces pa ltar rang gi sems dag ma dag tu snang ba las gzhan pa'i rang la 'khor 'das 'ching grol du snang ba med pas/ 'khor 'das gnyis snang gi chos thams cad sems kyi gnas skabs kyi chos su sdom ste/ lhan cig skyes pas gang skyes pa// lhan cig skyes pa de brjod bya// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod// rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /ces pa ltar rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa don gyi sdom par shes pa'i nges pa brtan po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ dbang don dag bya dag byed dam/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa gal che ste/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin// gsang sngags rten 'brel lam byed pas// rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i gdams ngag yin// phung po khams dang skye mched la// sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi// thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'tshang rgya ba'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad dbang nas bsgrigs dgos te/ de'ang chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par shes pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ kun rdzob tu ma dag par snang ba rnams lha so so'i dag pas sbyang bar bya dgos la/ des grol bar 'gyur ram zhe na grol te/ rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid// dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min// yul gyi dngos po dag pa'i phyir// rang gi rig pa'i bde ba mchog

/ces pa ltar sems 'khrul pa'i ngor/ ma dag par snang ba de nyid sngags kyis sbyangs nas/ rang rig pa'i ye shes su shes par byas te lhar bsgoms pas grol bar 'gyur te/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i phyir sbyang du rung zhing*/ glo bur gyi dri mas ma dag pa'i phyir sbyang dgos la/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha de glo bur dri bral du zhen nas zhugs pas/ zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel bas mi bslu ba'i phyir thabs des grol bar 'gyur ba yin no// de la sbyang gzhi rags pa phung khams skye mched du snang ba'i chos sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sbyang bya de dag la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog /sbyong byed gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sbyang tshul sbyang gzhi'i chos su snang ba de dang de dag sbyong byed kyi lha'am/ ye shes de rnams su kha dog bsgyur te bsgoms pas/ sbyangs 'bras lha sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ gdan gsum ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma'i gdan/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma'i gdan/ khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan te gsum/ de'ang nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la gdan gsum dngos su tshang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa gsum ga la gdan gsum rnam dag gi sgo nas tshang zhing*/ de bzhi ga la khyed rnams kyi phung khams skye mched gdan gsum tshang bar byin gyis rlobs pa'i cha nas/ gdan gsum phrin las kyi sgo nas tshang zhing*/ slob ma lhar bskyed 'gyur la'ang gdan gsum rnam dag gi sgo nas tshang bar shes shing bsgom pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dbang len dgos pas de rnams thugs la bzhag nas rig pa'i dbang lnga re re la/ gsol gdab dbang bskur rtogs bskyed bya// zhes pa ltar las/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dpal ldan thugs kyi nas bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis las bum gyi chus bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ khyed rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mi bskyod pa sogs nas sku can du gyur/ de nyid bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi zhal du zhugs sogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khod par gyur/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa bsang sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te sogs nas bum pa'i chur gyur/ bum pa de slob dpon gyis thogs nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi blang bar mdzod// ces pas khyed rnams la dbang len par gdams nas/ slob dpon gyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pa dang*/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga yum bzhi sogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rigs lngas byin gyis rlobs sogs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams khyed rnams kyi lus la thim pa ni/ rnam par shes pa la mi bskyod pa nas gshin rje gshed lag pa g.yon pa la thim/ de ltar khyed rnams kyi phung khams skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa'i skur gyur pa la/ nye bar spyod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shabda āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga nas rgyud la gzhag go /rin 'byung dbu rgyan gyi dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje nas// yon tan rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab nas brtsams te/ bdag 'jug ltar ser sna gshin rje gshed yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan nas blang bar mdzod/ ces gdams nas/ slob dpon gyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes dang*/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rigs lngas byin gyis brlab/

yum bzhis bum pa thogs/ slob dpon gyis dbu rgyan khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bcings te/ sangs rgyas kun dngos nas a haṃ/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blang*/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badzra u da ka sogs nas rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ḥbaṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams khyed rnams kyi phung khams skye mched so so la thim pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi skur gyur pa la mchod pa dang*/ rtogs bskyed bya ste sogs khong dang khyad chos thams cad bdag 'jug gi cho ga'i rigs 'gres gzhan 'jug pa'i tshig rnams bsgyur te/ rigs gzhan gsum la'ang des rigs 'gre sbyar ba'i dmigs bsal rnams bya'o// rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang la/ khyed rnams skad cig gis rigs lnga'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' nas skur gyur pa de la/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi slad du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin can re phyag g.yas su brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi don du byin pa mos/ 'di de nas hi hūm̐ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje de snying gar bzung nas/ snying ga'i nang du'ang rdo rje sems dpa' de 'dra ba zhig gis rgyas gdab pa sgom mdzod/ de dag gis ni ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga dang*/ phung po lnga sbyangs/ rig pa ye shes lnga dang sku lngar byin gyis brlabs pas na/ rig pa'i dbang lnga ste/ rdo rje slob ma'i las thams cad la dbang bar byas pas rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhes kyang bya'o// gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la/ gsol gdab dam tshig gsum dbang bskur// rnam dag brjod dang rjes gnang sbyin// zhes pa ltar lnga las/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

kye ho khyod kyi nas bdag 'gyur gsungs/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la khyed rnams rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs nas mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur par mos te/ slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje nas sgrubs shig ces gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rnams bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs song nas sngar gyi dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod par mos/ de la thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid ldan pa re phyag g.yas su rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi phyir byin te/ 'di de nas badzra hūm̐/ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje de smin mtshams su lan gsum du gsor te snying gar bzung nas/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod pa la thugs gtod mdzod/ thog mtha' med nas skyes bu'o// de'i don ni thog ma dang tha ma dang bral ba'i nas zung shig ces pa'o// gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu tshad dang mtshan nyid ldan pa phyag g.yon du dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi phyir byin te/ 'di de sangs rgyas nas ghaṇḍe aḥ zhes pas byin pa'i dril bu de dkrol te dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan te bzung nas/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid brjod pa la thugs gtod mdzod/ aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag nas byed par 'gyur/ de'i don ni/ srid pa thams cad rang bzhin nas zungs shig sku'i dam tshig gi slad du/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang nas bsdu bar gyis/ zhes gnang ba byin nas/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid brjod pa la thugs gtod mdzod/ srid pa'i bde ba nas brtan phyir ro// de'i don ni/

phyag rgya 'di snang stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo sku'i dam tshig tu shes par gyis shig de ltar na rdo rje nas rgya chen po mdzod cig ces dang*/ slob dpon gyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pa dang*/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas lag pa g.yon pa la thim par mos pa mdzod/ de ltar phung khams skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur gyur/ de la nye bar spyod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod de/ de la slob dpon phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis me tog gi char 'bebs shing khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol bar mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de ltar bum dbang gi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i slob mas sngags kyi sdom pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa yin no// de nas rnam dag bstan pa ni/ tshig 'di dag la gsan pas khyab ste/ gzhal yas khang gi sogs nas tshang ba'o// de'i don rten gzhal yas khang ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga la sogs pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun te/ lam gyi chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid yin la/ dur khrod ni lus kyi bu ga dgu dang 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad rnam par dag pa nyid/ phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du dur khrod kyi rnam par shar ba'o// srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar du gcod pa dang phyi rol gyi bdud dang bgegs kyi 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'o// brten pa lha rnams kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gti mug gshin rje gshed ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ ser sna gshin rje gshed ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/

'dod chags gshin rje gshid ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ tsartsi ka ni byams pa tshad med pa/ phag mo ni snying rje tshad med pa/ dbyangs can ma ni dga' ba tshad med pa/ go ri ni btang snyoms tshad med pa/ tho ba gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i sgo ba bzhi ni 'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom dbang du byed pa'i phrin las bzhi rnam par dag pa ste/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang zhing*/ rdo rje slob ma'i phung khams skye mched rnams la'ang de ltar du tshang bar byin gyis brlabs shing ngo 'phrod par byas pa yin no// de dag gi mtha' rten rjes gnang la/ sku dang sngags dang phyag mtshan dang*// dbyug tho mchod pa brtul zhugs dang*// dam tshig mig sman me long dang*// chos bshad dngos grub phrin las bzhi// ral gri mda' gzhu drag po'i las// zhes pa ltar las/ sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku lag tu gtad de lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom par rjes su gnang ba ni/ nyin re bzhin du nas yi dam zung*/ zhes dang*/ sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ni/ thal mo'i bar du me tog gi phreng ba bzung ste/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dbyer med pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros/ zhal nas 'thon te khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod par bsams la/ sngags kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ nye snying snying po rtsa sngags gsum dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa de la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos la lan gsum re bzlar gzhug slob dpon la me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs brjod/ slob dpon gyis me tog de sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rnams kyi dbu thog tu bzhag pas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas par mos shig

bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ de nas phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang ni/ khyed rnams gtso bor gsal ba'i phyag g.yas su gri gug byin pa 'phyar ba'i tshul re mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun sogs dang*/ phyag g.yon du thod khrag gtad de/ dngos dang dngos med nas btung bar bya/ zhes dang*/ dpa' bo'i phyag mtshan dbyug to'i rjes gnang ni/ lag pa g.yas su dbyug to byin te/ rdo rje thod dbyug nas zung zhig de ni bdud dang gshin rjer snang ba'i rtog pa gzhom pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis ces pa'i don du'o// mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ sdug pa'i gdong du zhes brjod/ de ni 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten pa thams cad kyang lha'i rnal 'byor gyis zhen med du longs spyod de bde stong zung 'jug gi mchod pas sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa'i bsam pas mnyes par gyis shig ces pa'i don to// brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ mchog gi dngos grub sogs brjod/ de ni gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas gang la'ang 'jigs pa med par spyad pa'i sgo nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub par gyis shig ces pa'i don to// dam tshig bsrung bar rjes su gnang ba ni/ ji ltar dbang bskur nas cho ga bzhin srungs zhes pa ste/ de ni ji ltar dbang bskur ba las thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs bsrungs pas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bar gyi dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur te/ de lta bu ni byang chub spyod tshogs gzhan gyis 'grub par dka' ba'i phyir/ de bas na rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams dang*/ dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du srung bar gyis shig ces pa'i don to// mig sman gyi rjes gnang ni/ khyed rnams kyi mig gnyis su pra gnyis bsams la/ gsal byed kyi thur mas drud pa'i tshul dang bcas te/ ji ltar mig mkhan nas praṃ/

zhes pas ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs bsal nas ye shes kyi spyan du byas nas/ me long gi rjes gnang ni/ a las skyes pa'i me long spyan gyi thad kar bstan te/ a chos rnams gzugs brnyan nas mnyam med kyis/ zhes pa ste/ de ni chos can gyi snang ba thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badzra he tu mām̐ zhes pas rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo byin te sems can 'khor ba las drangs shig ces dang*/ 'dren lugs ji ltar na/ oṃ badzra bhā ṣa raṃ/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su dung byin te/ dung bus la sems can rnams 'khor du sdus shig ces dang*/ tshul ji ltar na/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe aḥ zhes pas g.yon du dril bu byin te chos kyi sgra sgrogs shig ces dang*/ chos gang gis na/ a zhes pas pang du po ti byin te chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs shig ces pa'i don du ste/ khyod kyis the tshom nas gang bar gyis/ chos bshad pa de'ang gnas skabs su gdul bya so sor bsam pa dang mthun par theg pa gsum gang la gang 'dul ston dgos kyang*/ mthar thug de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rdo rje'i theg pa ston dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba la/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya rnams kyang mdzad pa zhu/ 'jig rten khams ni nas rab tu bskor/ zhes pa ste/ de'i don khyed rnams kyis/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ padma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bskor la/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig ces pa'i don to// dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ ral gri mig sman nas sgrub par gyis/ zhes pa ste/ de ni ral gri bzung nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad sgrub par gyis shig ces pa'o// phrin las sgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/

sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu byin la/ zhi ba'i sems kyi nas dbab par bya/ zhes pa ste/ de ni zhi rgyas dbang drag gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// ral gri'i rjes gnang ni/ khaṃ las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ral gri byin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi nas khaḍga hūm̐/ zhes pas byin te/ de ni shes rab kyi ral gri thogs nas spang bya ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang lta ba ngan pa'i drwa ba gcod pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang ni/ hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' lnga dang gzhu byin pa de phyogs kun du 'phen pa'i tshul mdzod cig chos rnams thabs dang nas/ a nu ra ga yā mi/ zhes pas byin te/ de ni rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom nas/ thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i don to// drag po'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ bsgral bar gyur ba'i nas las mdzod cig ces pa ste/ zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar ma gyur pa'i gdug pa can rnams bsad bskrad dbye rmongs la sogs pa gang 'dul thabs kyis tshar bcad de/ snying rje chen pos rjes su gzung ba'i sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po gyis shig ces pa ste/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las sogs nas rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o// de dag gis bum dbang 'khor dang bcas pa grub pa yin no// gsum pa mchog dbang gsum las/ dang po gsang dbang la/ yon dbul gsol gdab byang sems dbab// dbang bskur dngos dang mtha' rten sbyin// zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ slob dpon la gsang dbang gi rten phyag rgya mtshan nyid ldan pa dang maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje nas/ mgon pos rjes su gzung bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab/ sngon chad bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du/

ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing gdong bcing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥzhes pas nang mchod nas 'thor zhing slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum bsrungs la/ bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ phyag rgya rdo rje ro langs mar gsal ba gnyis ka'i mig tu sa'i snying po nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ste/ de'ang yab kyi sku gsung thugs dang skye mched kyi gnas su lha pho dang yum gyi gnas su lha mo'i gzugs su gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te hūm̐ las sogs nas gnyis ka'i bu gar phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum gyi spyan zur gyis lta res byas pas mig sa'i snying po yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ rna ba phan tshun dga' ba'i gtam dang bstod pa dang bsngags tshig gis rna ba phyag rdor yab yum sbyor bas mnyes/ yab yum gyi lus la gur gum tsandan ga bur la sogs pa'i dri bzang pos byugs te snom res byas pas/ sna nam mkha'i snying po yab yum sbyor bas mnyes par bsam/ bu ram dang sbrang rtsi dang li kha ra sbren ma dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa yum gyi lces blangs la yab kyi zhal du 'bul/ yab kyi lces blangs te yum gyi zhal du 'bul ba la sogs pa byas pas/ lce spyan ras gzigs yab yum sbyor bas mnyes par bsam/ 'khyud pa dang*/ 'o byed pa dang*/ nu ma nyed pa dang*/ mkhal khung 'tshir ba dang*/ sen mos 'debs pa dang*/ nor bu khas 'dzin pa dang*/ bha gar 'o byed pa la sogs pas ni/ lus sgrib pa rnams sel sbyor bas mnyes par bsam/ snying ga gnyis sprad pa ni yid kun tu bzang po yab yum sbyor bas mnyes par bsam/ dpral ba sbyar bas sku rdo rje yab yum sbyor bas mnyes par bsam/ mgrin pa sbyar bas gsung rdo rje yab yum sbyor bas mnyes par bsam/ snying ga sbyar bas thugs rdo rje yab yum sbyor bas mnyes par bsam/ de nas dkyil 'khor mar bsnubs te/ bde ba'i sgra ha ha dang si si kun tu ru badzra dhrika

ces bya ba'i sgra byung bas gshin rje gshed rigs lnga yab yum dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs pas sogs dag pa'i lam brgyud/ thabs kyi rdo rje nas thon/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu ba dang rang gi khu ba de padma las phyung la/ mthe bong dang ming med gnyis kyis rdo rje nor bu btsir nas lta ba dang reg pa'i yul ma yin pas so// de nyid khyed rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag ste gsang ba'i dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ btung ba rin po che 'di nas/ dhrika ham̐'uḥzhes pas byin pa de nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos la/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'thungs pas lus thams cad bde bas gang bar bsams la/ e ma bde ba chen po'o// zhes brjod/ de ltar gdan gsum tshang ba'i thig le myangs pas mgrin pa'i ya ra la wa'i rtsa 'khor brgyud de/ lus thams cad la khyab pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rags rim 'gags te/ gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ khyed rnams 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gyur par bsgoms la cung zad mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mig dar 'grol/ de'i mtha' rten du lung ston pa ni/ lung phal cher sprul sku rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa can gyis ston srid pas/ skabs 'dir slob dpon shākya thub pa'i cha lugs su bsgyur te/ lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa seṅge'i rna ba ltar byas la/ g.yas pas rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste lung bstan pa ni/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro nas thams cad kyis lung bstan par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya'i stobs zab mo 'di la dad par gyis shig de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor nas bsgrigs pa'o// des gsang dbang grub nas/

dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis ka la/ gsol gdab dbang bskur mtha' rten sbyin// zhes pa ltar las/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje nas deng bdag stsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du/ 'bru lngas mig dar dang*/ bdud rtsis bsrung ba sngar bzhin byas la/ de'ang phyag rgya ni dung can/ padma ri mo can la sogs pa mtshan dang ldan pa yid du 'ong ba zhig la/ gsang ba'i kun du spyod pa la mi dad pa spong ba'i phyir 'di ltar brjod de/ 'khor ba'i phun sum tshogs pa rnams ni/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ de bas na srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de thob par byed pa'i thabs la'ang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya ste/ byams pa'i zhal nas/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams// gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te// nyan thos kyi ni sa rnams dang*// rang sangs rgyas kyi sa rnams gegs// zhes bshad/ theg chen la'ang*/ pha rol phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags gnyis las/ pha rol tu phyin pa lam sdug bsngal gyis 'bras bu bde ba sgrub pa zhes bya ste/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du lus sbyin pa btang ba la sogs pa'i dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad dgos/ gsang sngags ni lam bde bas 'bras bu bde ba sgrub pa zhes bya ste/ nyon mongs pa spyad pas 'tshang rgya ba yin te/ kye rdo rje las/ ji ltar me yis tshig pa la// me de nyid la gdungs par bya// zhes bya ba la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa'i lam mchog rgyud sde rin po che nas bstan pa'i thabs lam zab mo la ma dad pa'i sems dang bral bar byas nas/ skrag pa dang ngo tsha ba'i rnam thar dor bar byos shig ces gdams pa la/

phyag rgya de shin tu dgyes pas lus dri bzang po'i chus byug te/ dar sngon po'i ral ga dang dmar po'i cod paṇa gyis bcings te/ gdub bu dang phreng ba dang me long la sogs pas brgyan te/ slob dpon gyis phyag rgya'i lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag nas bzung*/ slob ma'i srin lag g.yas pa dang mdud pa'i tshul gyis gtod par mos te/ khyer cig khyer cig nas rtag tu gyis/ zhes gtad pa'i phyag rgya des kyang*/ khyed rnams la rtog pa med dam zhes brtag pa'i phyir dri ba byas par mos/ dri chen dri chu nas spro ba yin nam ci/ zhes dris pa la de ltar spro ba'i lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dri chen nas cis mi spro zhes lan btab/ de nas khyed rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ phyag rgya rdo rje ro langs mar gsal ba/ gnyis ka'i mig tu sa'i snying po nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ste/ de'ang yab kyi gnas su lha pho dang yum gyi gnas su lha mo bsgom pa sngar bzhin byas la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa māḥdzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ de nas khyed rnams zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs su gnas par bsams la/ bla mas gnyis ka'i srin lag nas bzung ste/ gzungs ma 'di ni nas myang bar gyis/ zhes brjod/ phyag rgya des kyang dri zhim pos bsgos pa'i chu skyes ngom bzhin pas/ e ma nga yi padma nas bhañdza hoḥ zhes brjod kyin pang du byon pa na/ khyed rnams thabs shes rab lhar gsal ba'i mkha' gsang byin rlabs sngar bzhin dang*/ gnyis ka'i spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sogs nas lte ba la phaṭa dang bcas pa gong ltar gsal gdab/ khyed rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum gyi spyan zur gyi lta res byas pas mig sa'i snying po yab yum sbyor bas mnyes sogs skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams sbyor bas mnyes par gong bzhin byas/

rang dang phyag rgya lha'i skur gsal ba sku'i 'du shes/ hi hi si si kun du ru badzra dhrika ces sbrogs pa ngag gi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes ye shes mngon du bya snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod par bya snyam pa ni chos kyi 'du shes dang ma bral bar snyoms par zhugs pas/ yab kyi spyi bo'i haṃ las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun rtsa dbu ma'i lam nas babs te/ mgrin pa'i oṃ la phog pas dga' ba/ de snying ga'i hūm̐ la phog pas mchog dga'/ de lte ba'i oṃ la phog pas dga' bral/ de gsang gnas kyi phaṭa la phog pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsam/ de bar du rol mo'i sgra bde ba mi gsal ba'o// bde ba cher skyes pas sa bon nyams su dogs na rkang pa'i mthe bong bskum pa la sogs pa dang*/ heg ces brjod pas thig le lte bar phyin pas dga' ba/ snying gar phyin pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par phyin pas dga' bral/ spyi bor 'o ma lud pa ltar phyin pa dang lus sprugs pas rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab/ de'i tshe smra ba dang bsam pa dang brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i don gyi ye shes 'char ba ni lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o// zhes dang*/ dril gsil me tog 'thor ba dang rol mo drag tu bya zhing*/ ā li kā li brjod do// ye shes de nyid slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i glu'i sgo nas ngo sprad pa 'di la sems ma yengs par gtod mdzod/ e ma rnal 'byor pa yi ji srid nas// ye shes mngon sbyor gyis gnas bya// zhes pa ste/ sku gsum lam byed kyi 'du shes gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dngos sam ye shes kyi rig ma la brten nas byung ba'i yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi dang*/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du byas nas sems dang bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bskyed par gyis shig ces pa'i don to// de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/

dbang de thob pa'i brdar mig ras 'grol/ de'i mtha' rten du dbugs dbyung ba ni/ 'dod chags bral ba nas thob par 'gyur/ zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni yul lha dang bla ma dang*/ gzhan don la chags pa ni dam tshig chen po yin pas chags pa de gsum dang ma bral bar gyis shig de bas na khyed rnams bde ba chen po 'bras bu'i theg pa 'dir tshud pas/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal na ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa las shin tu 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub spyod pa bde ba'i sgo nas thob par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ sngags dang rgyud rnams nas rtag tu bsrung ba mdzad/ ces pa ste/ de'i don ni khyed rnams sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen por dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pas mthun par gsungs shing*/ bu sdug pa ltar yongs su dgongs pa'i phyir/ deng phyin chad sems can rnams la snying brtse ba sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su bya ba rnams tshul bzhin du bsgrub ste byang chub kyi lam sgrub pa rnams sngags kyi theg pa la sbyor bar gyis shig de ltar byas na sangs rgyas rnams la bya ba byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan 'dogs pa dang*/ bstan pa'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams drin du gzo bar 'gro bas na/ de dag gi mkhyen brtse nus pas rtag tu bsrung bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'o// de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor sogs nas rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o// gsum pa dbang bzhi pa la/ tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ khyod zhabs padma'i nas bskyab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ sngon chad don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du mig dar dang bdud rtsis 'thor ba 'dra/ 'dir dbang bzhi pa ni/
